entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available via an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It provides automated fact extraction and user profile maintenance with sub-300ms recall at high scale.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. It is designed to reduce token spend and provides observable retrieval through directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents extracts entity relationships into a knowledge graph without requiring LLM calls. It supports local deployment using PGLite and generates cited prose answers while identifying information gaps.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system focuses on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible through Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library serves as the upstream component for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It offers a FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs, supporting hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like versioning via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features an interactive TUI and REPL interface with sub-100ms retrieval.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system utilizes a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes vector search and structured facts to manage persistent memory. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This context harness supports Python and TypeScript environments to assist agents with complex tasks. It provides CLI tools for solving and simulating tasks while generating filesystem-based traces and knowledge artifacts.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a DAG-based engine and a SQLite-backed message store to prevent message loss. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG to facilitate searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that enables portable state across clients like Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It imports data from sources such as Obsidian and GitHub, achieving a reported 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open YAML engram format to store plain-text memories for multi-agent systems. It supports Hermes and Claude Code while providing local-first, zero-cost search capabilities.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, including BM25 and vector search, and integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It offers native plugin support for Hermes Agent, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saving up to 36% in tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that avoids vector databases and embeddings in favor of SQLite with FTS5 search. The five-package plugin family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a 'why_retrieved' label. It supports in-process embedded mode by default and includes a self-directing loop to address knowledge gaps.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by prefetching context based on agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and functions as an MCP-native server for major coding agents.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn enables cross-project memory by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memories as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only necessary context. This local-first layer supports stdio and SSE MCP servers while reporting up to 94% fewer prompt tokens.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tools. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin employs a pull-model and an on-demand summarizer to manage agent state. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate payments for AI agent operations.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It offers tools for manual memory storage and searching, featuring configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution. It utilizes HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing for dense and exact-text recall.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for managing and searching local artifacts. It includes a proactive router skill and supports automatic tool-OKF generation through an opt-in process.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining vector, BM25, and graph methods, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories via localhost. It enables semantic and literal code search alongside grounded Q&A that includes file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It includes specific phases for brainstorming and design refinement to support effective software development.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports through automation and plugin features. It is compatible with various coding agents and local CLI executables, including Hermes Agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It supports Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients to build knowledge graphs from ingested data.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It features self-check and auto-fix capabilities to generate diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It utilizes a 112-entry word replacement table and is compatible with Hermes and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement to unify skills across multiple agents and devices. It integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 12 metaskills that preserve state in a docs/ folder. These spec-conformant Agent Plugins are compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals through escrow and dispute resolution. It includes a master router, connector skills, and vendored official protocol skills.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection includes 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It offers ready-to-paste exports for use with ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation while providing slash commands for management.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides access to YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists via TranscriptAPI. It is compatible with the Agent Skills format and works with Hermes Agent and Cursor.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It includes a reporting mechanism that identifies analysis blind spots alongside findings.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It features a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running agents through a three-level work model and structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files and automates the capture of high-value decisions. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This toolkit follows the Agent Skills specification to integrate CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides skills in SKILL.md format along with installation and configuration guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models. It includes code examples and a suite of six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool extracts function signatures and types from code and documentation to create agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides version-pinned skills with an audit trail.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification via a Python SkilldockClient and CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution and includes TON payment commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It features real-time progress and decision tracking alongside built-in rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika serves as a workflow language for AI that provides static auditing via nika check. It supports local-first execution with any LLM and generates hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and provides incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill uses a 5-layer retrieval system, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and provides graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases and integration risks. It includes a deterministic pre-scan layer and an MCP server to generate suppression rules.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and integrates federated search with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It features a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This.NET implementation of agentskills.io supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill employs a three-agent swarm to target hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness in code. It uses a risk-tiered triage system and includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This tool provides a functional quality seal for AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker environments. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for skill submission and verification.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Compatible with the agentskills.io open standard, this collection includes capabilities for video-to-text processing, document OCR for PDFs and scans, and e-commerce material creation. It supports video-to-text functionality for local files or Douyin links.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and provides configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows and offers a configurable gateway mode.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides Hermes Agent sandboxing through hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It allows for kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access and configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This production package can run as a TUI, Desktop app, or Gateway. It includes bundled CPython 3.12 and PortableGit, and supports side-by-side execution with an installed Hermes instance.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multi-agent LLM financial trading, incorporating fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It facilitates structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers and supports Docker deployment.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers container sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes and other coding agents. It runs entirely on local hardware across Windows, macOS, and Linux, featuring an auto-sync capability to keep the graph current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and visualization dashboard that tracks token usage and associated costs for multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It monitors local data files to provide detailed analytics on consumption across various models and providers.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from agents like Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent-to-provider communications.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help developers build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, supporting any AI provider that utilizes markdown or general prompting.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes and other CLI tools directly from local paths. It distinguishes itself by synchronizing usage data and session details across multiple machines simultaneously.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It comes pre-loaded with 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the terminal UI of Hermes with various community-contributed themes, such as retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It uses a YAML-based configuration system to modify visual elements like banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing identity registration with human-readable handles and encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It enables Hermes agents to engage in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM and GGUF inference as well as reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar to manage complex workflows. It supports multiple providers like Anthropic and OpenAI while offering a unique undo functionality for recent agent-driven changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This repository provides a suite of integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, alongside editor tooling for VS Code. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code designed to capture prompts and tool traces for analysis.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve reported token savings of 90-99% during agent operations. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and research, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configurations, skills, and memories. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents through project-local instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services to enable rapid deployment. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It analyzes multiple file formats to detect issues such as conflicting directives or missing limits using HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing to discover, monitor, and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides fully local, offline interaction with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides an all-in-one interface to manage multiple agentic tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that provides a unified interface for multiple external agents like Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. It features 21 built-in professional assistants and enables remote access via WebUI, Telegram, Lark, DingTalk, and WeChat.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed to provide full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. The layout features three panels including chat and a workspace file browser for use on web browsers or mobile phones.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages sessions, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics. It supports 10 platform channels including Telegram and Discord and includes visual workflow building and Kanban task tracking.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog. It includes a Monaco editor, PTY terminal, and a file browser, supporting Swarm Mode with tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and other CLI agents. It supports delegation to sub-agents and is available as a desktop or self-hosted app with native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides embedded terminal access for system repair and native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that supports Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports Markdown and LaTeX rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent gateways. It includes Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting and Hermes Web Alpha for session and runtime management.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents. It allows users to manage tasks, sessions, and skills while providing read-only access to analytics and agent memory.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage alongside a live workspace for monitoring diffs and code writes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser and agent cockpit. It provides searchable history for ten supported agent sources and live per-session quota burn tracking with local-only data processing.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with file attachments and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents and web dashboards. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It offers real-time session activity and cost tracking alongside read-only inspection of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client for orchestrated multi-agent collaboration between 20 specialized agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
